mechanism.owner: lib/command.js region mpd-delta explicit-team-fallback (ensureExplicitTeam + the shared resolveExplicitTeamText bridge), wired from lib/index.js into the generic command, every generated profile command, and the plain-text gesture boundary.
mechanism.sameTurn: Staging happens INSIDE the invocation handler (command handler or pre-step gesture boundary), so it is the same turn by construction; the model keeps the primary path and the plugin is the deterministic fallback.
mechanism.askFirst: When a team already exists the resolver never reuses and never creates: it returns an inquiry naming the existing team plus the two options. Participant matching is supplemented by an unapproved-staged-team scan, because a fresh headless boot carries a NEW session id and participant matching alone would silently stage a duplicate plan.
mechanism.silentFailures: An unavailable profile roster, a staging throw, an ambiguous session (two teams) and a disabled slash-command surface each produce a visible WARNING; the failure path was exercised repeatedly during development and always surfaced as WARNING, never silence.
